uses: bounded visual art direction and review

contentAcknowledgment: Code and explanatory text were developed with AI assistance. Review and validation evidence is recorded separately; this acknowledgment does not claim correctness or eligibility certification.
numericalData: Positions, terrain horizons and visibility samples are computed by deterministic code from cited NASA/PDS/PGDA/NAIF resources. These numbers are not generated or estimated by a language model.
imagery: Privately labeled AI-generated UI concepts informed the design; none is shipped as scientific output. Deployed imagery and visual elevation derive from credited NASA SVS/LROC/LOLA, Blue Marble and Gaia-based star-map resources. Conversion methods and hashes accompany each asset. The interactive scene is a code rendering: global and local terrain are visual geometry, scale adjustments are labeled, and numerical visibility uses separate published-data horizon calculations. The true-scale revision adds attributed Solar System Scope CC BY 4.0 illustrative cloud/specular masks over NASA ground imagery, plus code-based optical atmosphere/glare. Fixed clouds are not simulated weather. No AI-generated planet imagery is deployed.
humanDirection: The user specified guided and unrestricted navigation, faithful and free simulation, independent freezes, immersive display, separate screens and the visual direction. Earlier research and planning were AI-assisted; no claim is made that the official interpretation of the ideation restriction has been resolved.
limitations: The project is an educational prototype, not NASA-authored output, operational guidance or a safety certification. Completion and check status must be read in the evidence page and project checkpoints.
